copy.heading: Arrival
copy.subheading: Induction for household members returning from long-term golf.
body: Welcome home. Please leave your clubs at the front door. The front door, Dave. Not the downstairs loo, and not the boot of Sue's car, which she needs on Thursday.

illustration.concept: Dave on the doorstep with his golf bag on his shoulder, cap on, as Sue holds the door open with a toddler on her hip and Alfie peers round her legs from the hallway.
